title: A Lesson for the Master
description: As the Clone Wars drew to a close, Yoda faced a myriad of unexpected trials. He was guided to the world "where all life began" by Qui-Gon Jinn's encouraging spirit. There, five mysterious, Force-wielding Priestesses tasked the diminutive Jedi Master with dark temptations. Finally, on Moraband, the ancient homeworld of the Sith, Yoda completed his unique journey of discovery by confronting Darth Sidious...and emerged from his extended ordeal with new wisdom.
